Roadmap

PHASE 1

THE BEGINNING

  • Born in a Farcaster channel when the protocol was still young
  • 15% airdropped to early Farcaster users, 15% added to liquidity pools
  • Surpassed 5,000 wallets within days of launch
  • Introduced tipping as a new way to share Degen and reward creators
PHASE 2

The Degen Chain

  • Reached $1B market cap within 4 months
  • 1Confirmation invested $1M, the only official investor to date
  • Launched the Degen Chain, expanding utility beyond a meme
  • Cemented status as one of the top meme tokens on Base
PHASE 3

Into the mainstream

  • First Base-native token listed on Coinbase
  • Added listings on Bybit and Binance Futures
  • Community grew beyond Farcaster into a broader retail audience
  • Degen proved that a community-led meme could break into the mainstream
PHASE 4

The next chapter

  • Building the Degen App, the next social super app to expand the
  • Continuing to grow the meme and its cultural presence
  • Focused on scaling the community and strengthening the brand
